summary: The player weaves through pink bullets in the upper playfield while charging up a shot, releases a level 2 charged shot into empty space at the top edge, and shortly after collides with a pink bullet and loses a life.

events.evidence: Player ship shifts right and slightly up to dodge incoming pink bullets.
Player ship moves slightly left and down as the charge meter fills to 2 bars.
WAIT meter had 2 filled bars and resets to 0; a wide cyan crescent projectile fires upward with a whoosh/discharge sound.
The cyan crescent shot travels off the top edge of the screen without hitting any enemy.
Player moves left and then right while navigating pink bullets.
Player ship contacts a pink bullet near the top; screen border flashes red, an explosion ring expands from the ship, lives drop from 5 to 4, and a heavy hit/explosion sound plays.

readability_issues.issue: Circular pink ripple/spawn indicators on the lane floor look very similar in color and shape to the active pink bullets, making it slightly harder to distinguish active hazards from floor telegraph rings.
